C0375.title: Three Sentenced for Stealing 370,000 Yuan in Tips by Hacking Accounts
C0375.summary: In Nanjing, a creator surnamed Liu was suddenly unable to log into an account used for seven years. After recovering it in May 2024, Liu found that 800 yuan in tips had been withdrawn. Police found that three individuals, including Lin, used third-party software to obtain platform account credentials, replaced the bound WeChat accounts, and withdrew the funds, with Li stealing no less than 190,000 yuan and Wang no less than 180,000 yuan. The court convicted both of theft, sentencing Li to three years and two months and Wang to two years and four months, plus fines.
